description: Get the DNS answers recorded for one scan when it ran: the scanned hostnames, the registrable domain's mail servers, nameservers, TXT, SOA, CAA, _dmarc and wildcard records, reverse-DNS names of its addresses and, on a sample of scans, the addresses of third-party hosts the page contacted, with a summary of the mail, SPF, DMARC and wildcard setup. recorded is false for scans before 28 October 2026 or whose lookup has not finished. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
